title: Keep scoped Linux accessibility requests fast and follow GNOME recording formats.
changes: Apply PID and application selectors before probing unrelated AT-SPI applications, preserving stable semantic targets and bounded UI waits.
Follow GNOME's actual MP4 or WebM recording path instead of assuming the requested filename template is the output file.
Confine returned recordings to their private staging directory and UUID stem; reject symlinks, empty files and explicit destination format mismatches.
Cover scoped snapshot/action wiring, both GNOME formats, default output and destination preservation with subprocess regressions and native Linux checks.
